keywords.title: Role keywords
keywords.description: Job title or skill keywords to match, e.g. ['LLM', 'AI', 'machine learning', 'data engineer', 'Full stack web developer'].

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Geographic filters such as ['US', 'Canada', 'Remote']. Leave empty to search all.

max_results.title: Max number of jobs
max_results.description: Maximum number of matching job posts to process.

remote_only.title: Remote only
remote_only.description: If enabled, include only remote jobs where supported by the source.

seniority.title: Seniority level filter
seniority.description: Optional seniority filter such as 'junior', 'mid', 'senior'. Leave empty for any.

language.title: Outreach language
language.description: Language for the generated outreach messages, e.g. 'English' or 'Spanish'.

required_tech_keywords.title: Required tech keywords
required_tech_keywords.description: Only keep jobs whose description contains at least one of these terms, e.g. ['Python','TypeScript','AWS']. Leave empty to keep all.

exclude_company_keywords.title: Exclude company keywords
exclude_company_keywords.description: Drop jobs where the company name or description contains any of these terms, e.g. ['recruitment','agency'].

campaign_name.title: Campaign name
campaign_name.description: Optional label stored with each lead, e.g. 'US LLM agencies Dec 2025'.

your_name.title: Your name for signatures
your_name.description: Used to personalize email and DM signatures.

max_leads_per_source.title: Max leads per source
max_leads_per_source.description: Upper limit of leads to keep from each job source before merging.

skip_llm_if_no_snippet.title: Skip LLM if no snippet
skip_llm_if_no_snippet.description: If enabled, leads without a description/snippet will be dropped before outreach generation.
